newsitem.title: USA: Roadway says to raise rates by 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Roadway says to raise rates by 5.7 pct.

text.p: Transportation services company Roadway Express Inc on Friday said it will raise rates overall by about 5.7 percent, from January 1, 1997.
Roadway will also raise its minimum charge floor to $46.00 and adjust rates for specific lanes and certain connecting-line routes.
The fuel surcharge Roadway enacted on September 3, 1996 will remain separate from the motor carrier's general rate structure, the company said.
